ops.title: Orca exposes lane-to-Run binding publicly, but no public coordinator-terminal-to-Claude-session map
ops.body:
Observed 2026-10-02 on Orca 1.4.218 (grants-core-3), for automatic adoption of a Run coordinator's grants into an Orca lane's tree.

Public and trustworthy: a worker terminal's env carries ORCA_TERMINAL_HANDLE and ORCA_PANE_KEY (also ORCA_AGENT_LAUNCH_TOKEN, ORCA_WORKTREE_ID, ORCA_TAB_ID; no run, dispatch, or coordinator id). 'orca orchestration worker-list --json' maps agentTerminalHandle to dispatchId and runId (dispatchStatus dispatched for live lanes). It pages newest first, 540 rows here, about 0.16 s per page, and takes no terminal filter. '--terminal-state active' returned 0 because orca-launch.sh workers are external and read 'retained'. 'orca orchestration run-show --id <run> --json' gives coordinator_handle and coordinator_pane_key. 'run-current --from <worker handle>' returns run null.

Missing: no public Orca CLI maps a coordinator terminal to its Claude session id. 'terminal show' and 'terminal list' carry agentIdentity but no session. In orchestration.db, runs.coordinator_orca_session_id and dispatch_contexts.assignee_orca_session_id are NULL. The only record is Orca-internal: ~/Library/Application Support/orca/agent-hooks/last-status.json, entries[<tabId:leafId pane key>].providerSession.id (here 900424b6 for run_7715a23a5657, with launchTokenHash). It is last status per pane, so a nested claude -p inheriting ORCA_PANE_KEY can overwrite it.

Options sent to capt-hook-grants: (A) public CLI for lane to Run to pane, then last-status.json for the session id; (B) capt-hook records terminal handle to tree from attended top-level sessions' hook env; (C) ask Orca to fill coordinator_orca_session_id, manual 'capt-hook grant adopt' meanwhile.
